name: The Maybourne Beverly Hills
positioning: The former Montage Beverly Hills, now Maybourne's first US hotel, in the Golden Triangle one block from Rodeo Drive
best_for: Shoppers who want to walk to Rodeo Drive

facts.text: The hotel is in Beverly Hills 90210, one block from Rodeo Drive.
The hotel is in the Golden Triangle of Beverly Hills.
The hotel sits beside Beverly Cañon Gardens, with shopping and dining within walking distance.
The hotel is the former Montage Beverly Hills property.
It is the Maybourne Hotel Group's first hotel in the US.
Interiors use mid-century classic furniture and modern artwork created by LA locals.
Rooms have Dyson hair dryers, Cowshed amenities, 600 thread count linens and floor-to-ceiling windows.
The spa offers Dr. Barbara Sturm facials, including The Maybourne Sturmglow facial, created exclusively for the spa.
The rooftop pool has poolside chaises and private cabanas.
Dante Beverly Hills is the first West Coast outpost of the New York City restaurant and bar.
The Terrace overlooks the lawns of Beverly Cañon Gardens, with the charm of a European piazza.
The hotel received the Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star award for 2026, for the second year in a row.

highlights.text: The rooftop pool is on the 9th floor, planted with native trees and flowers, with a Mediterranean beach resort ambiance.
The 20,000-square-foot spa includes a riad-style mineral pool, saunas, Turkish steam rooms and Balinese-inspired relaxation rooms.
Suite experiences range from live pianists to in-suite cocktail experiences and use of BMW i7 sedans to explore LA.
Suites have balconies where guests can have breakfast with views of the plaza below.
Suites feature collectible artworks, sumptuous bathrooms and mid-century-inspired furnishings.

considerations.text: This is a city hotel in the heart of Beverly Hills' Golden Triangle; its pool is on the 9th-floor rooftop.
The hotel is one block from Rodeo Drive, not on it.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the ultra-luxury positioning.
